title: Install Amendment B standing engineering policy authorization
problem: The working renewable engineering identity has only metadata actions. The new governing scope removes per-release human approval inside a genuine grant, but the deployed Controller lacks the bounded unattended admission and policy-provisioning path.
expected_behavior: Release 24252d51c8d46089e5aa7cbc834e6feff40bd254; manifest ab75f021eb275ba6be41944474cac0605f870ece04d1c30776d9126598e9dd85. Deploy only the pinned Engineering Control/runtime/frontend and additive migrations under existing legitimate restricted administration; enable no grant merely by installation.
change_purpose: Implement standing revocable policy admission without owner-session impersonation, workload self-grants, fabricated approval records or recurring per-release owner clicks.
feature_improvement: Permit eligible routine releases to register, test, commit, deploy and verify through existing authenticated infrastructure with source, CI, rollback and audit protections.
regression_rules: Do not enable, expand or impersonate a workload grant using the executing workload.
Preserve all owner records, customer grants, data, working communications and external provider protections.
Preserve V4 30, workspace 46, the single-pilot allowlist, Gmail confirmation and memory ingestion.
Preserve Auth verification, scoped revocation, exact source/version guards, component locks and compatible rollback.
acceptance_criteria: 189 composed tests, 26 isolated PostgreSQL assertions and five release transport tests pass.
Verify real administrator provisioning, two unattended routine production cycles and revoke/expiry/target/risk/source negative canaries before claiming operational autonomy.
Keep source verification distinct from customer quality and cross-channel acceptance.
